questions.question: Compare non-skill-based and skill-based adventure water sports. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Compare non-skill-based and skill-based adventure water sports. [U] / [CO1] Non-skill-based:
  • • Requires minimal training
  • • Easy to participate
  • • Safer and beginner- friendly
  • • Examples: Banana boat ride, kayaking (basic) Skill-based:
  • • Requires training and experience
  • • Higher risk involved
  • • Needs technical knowledge
  • • Examples: Scuba diving, surfing Comparison:
  • • Skill level: Low vs High
  • • Risk: Low vs High
  • • Training: Not required vs Essential
  • • Equipment use: Basic vs Advanced

questions.question: Describe atmospheric pressure and its significance in meteorology. / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe atmospheric pressure and its significance in meteorology. [U] / [CO5]
  • • Atmospheric pressure is the force exerted by air on Earth’s surface
  • • Measured using barometer
  • • Decreases with altitude
  • • High pressure = stable weather
  • • Low pressure = storms and rain
  • Significance:
  • • Helps predict weather changes
  • • Influences wind patterns
  • • Important for aviation and navigation
  • • Affects climate and environment
  • • Helps in forecasting cyclones
